limitations: Includes the 13 location categories configured in the game map collection table. The development map Test is excluded.
Access to the two additional region definitions has not been verified; their entries should not automatically be treated as missed items.
Key items and keys are map marker categories and do not contribute to the seven-category game completion total.
Whole-flower parent entries are retained for reference. The game skips whole-flower parents with multiple petals when counting completion.
A related quest, event, or whole flower is not evidence of a prerequisite. Entries without verified prerequisite logic remain unverified.
An item may have several source locations. Location counts here differ from game totals deduplicated by item ID.
Some key-item entries identify only a container actor, with no item ID. Their names are unverified. Four source entries have no configured coordinates.
